name: spectralnorm
algorithm: Spectral norm of the infinite matrix A(i,j) = 1/((i+j)(i+j+1)/2+i+1) by 10 power iterations of AtA (the Benchmarks Game's spectral-norm, scalar) (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: not needed for the budgets; A(i, j)'s integer arithmetic is checked in mk

no_counts: B24: no data-dependent control flow; 10 power iterations of fixed n by n products, and the float checksum is sensitive to operation order
